Because the zephyr stake is held until the delta settlement, the operator carries real capital per endorsement, and the hollow audit lists each exposure. An attester must stake 35% of the reward its attestation would unlock, so endorsing a high-value answer costs proportionally more than endorsing a inexpensive one. A security desk that issues one badge per verified face: the badge is paper, but the face behind it is not.
